stem:
The diagram shows sunlight heating a pond, water vapour rising to form a cloud, and moving air carrying the cloud. Kiara links these Earth factors to living things.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Water in the pond is part of the hydrosphere and is essential for life.
Sunlight heats Earth so that water vapour can form clouds and later bring rain that refills water sources.
Moving air and rainfall have no effect on which plants and animals can live in a place.
Habitats for living beings come first, and that produces sunlight, water movement, and air movement.

teacher.key_rationale: Water (hydrosphere) is essential; sunlight drives evaporation, clouds, and rain; moving air and rainfall help shape habitats. C denies that link; D reverses cause and effect.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote lens-ray figure into pond, vapour, cloud, moving air, and sunlight.
